setup_command: CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build
launch_command:
mkdir -p .clawgap-state && cat > .clawgap-state/openclaw.json <<EOF
{"gateway":{"mode":"local","auth":{"mode":"token","token":"clawgap-loopback-mock"}},"agents":{"defaults":{"model":{"primary":"clawgap/clawgap-environment-probe"},"skipBootstrap":true}},"models":{"providers":{"clawgap":{"baseUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT}/v1","apiKey":"clawgap-loopback-mock","api":"openai-completions","models":[{"id":"clawgap-environment-probe","name":"ClawGap Environment Probe","reasoning":false,"input":["text"],"cost":{"input":0,"output":0,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0},"contextWindow":128000,"maxTokens":128}]}}}}
EOF
OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="$PWD/.clawgap-state" OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH="$PWD/.clawgap-state/openclaw.json" node dist/entry.js agent --agent main --message 'environment probe' --json --timeout 30
